name: sysketch-mcp

tools.name: render_diagram
tools.description:
Render a system design diagram from a tiny YAML spec. Writes an .svg/.png file and returns its path. Never write SVG yourself.
Spec keys: title, theme (graphite|blueprint|midnight|classic|sketch), direction (right|down), steps (false hides step numbers),
nodes {id: "icon | Label"}, groups {Label: [ids]}, edges ["a > b", "a > b > c", "a > b | label"].
Ids that are icon names/aliases (client, lb, api, db, cache, redis, kafka, s3, cdn...) need no nodes entry.
To edit, change the spec file and call again with file=.

file.description: Path to a spec file (preferred; edit it, then re-render)

preview.description: Return a PNG image to inspect. Only when the user asks you to look (~1-2k tokens)

tools.name: list_icons
tools.description: List sysketch icon names and their aliases.
